[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 10:34  
[FACT] User is interested in the nutritional values of pet food products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nutritional values of pet food products are determined by laboratory analysis and feeding trials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Laboratory analysis involves chemical analysis of the ingredients to determine nutrient composition.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feeding trials involve feeding the pet food to animals and monitoring their health and well-being.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pet food companies may consult with veterinary nutritionists and follow guidelines set by AAFCO (the Association of American Feed Control Officials).  
[USER] User expresses surprise that feeding trials are part of determining nutritional values in pet food.  
[USER] User asks if Pedigree conducts feeding trials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is common for pet food companies to conduct feeding trials to ensure products meet nutritional needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feeding trials involve monitoring the health and well-being of animals fed the food for a certain period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Animals in feeding trials are chosen to represent the intended target population (e.g., puppies, adult dogs, senior dogs).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feeding trials provide information on digestibility, palatability, and overall nutritional adequacy of the food.  
[USER] User finds it interesting that nutritional values are tested on actual animals to ensure they meet nutritional needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Analyzing ingredients is important, but feeding trials are crucial to ensure food is nutritionally balanced.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] AAFCO requires pet food to undergo feeding trials or meet certain nutrient levels to be considered nutritionally complete and balanced.  
[USER] User wants to ensure they are giving their pets the best food possible.  
[USER] User asks for recommendations for high-quality pet food brands.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some widely recognized high-quality pet food brands include Hill's Science Diet, Royal Canin, Orijen, Acana, Blue Buffalo, Wellness, and Taste of the Wild.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Not all pets have the same nutritional needs; what works for one may not work for another.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended to consult with a veterinarian to determine specific nutritional needs of pets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Select a high-quality pet food brand that meets the specific requirements of the pet.
